sector.quote: Our customer base primarily comprises reputable international companies in the semiconductor, aerospace, and data storage industries.

business_description.value: The company provides precision component engineering services, including precision machining and precision welding, mainly to customers in the semiconductor industry, as well as aerospace and data storage customers.
business_description.quote: The Group sells parts that undergo the precision machining process which includes turning, milling, grinding and drilling, etc.
